example.thai: มีพัสดุมาส่งไหมครับ
example.phonetic: mii phát-sà-dù maa sòng mǎi khráp
example.english: Has any parcel arrived for me?

words.note: Thai condos log deliveries into parcel rooms; staff will often check an app or register for your unit.

example.thai: ติดต่อนิติได้ที่ชั้นหนึ่ง
example.phonetic: dtìt-dtɔ̀ɔ ní-dtì dâai thîi chán nèung
example.english: You can contact the juristic office on the first floor.

words.note: A spoken abbreviation of 'นิติบุคคล' (ní-dtì-bùk-khon); residents almost exclusively use this shorter form.

example.thai: ขอเลขห้องด้วยครับ
example.english: May I have your room number, please?

words.note: Condo staff identify residents by unit number rather than name, so have your room digits ready.

words.english: to come pick up, to collect

example.thai: มารับพัสดุครับ
example.english: I've come to pick up a parcel.

words.note: Use this straightforward phrase when you walk up to the front desk to immediately state your purpose.

example.thai: รบกวนเซ็นชื่อตรงนี้ครับ
example.english: Please sign your name right here.

words.note: You will usually need to sign a physical logbook or digital tablet before collecting your deliveries.
